mainEntity.name: How do I keep AI content specific when the same workflow supports different audiences?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt the workflow around the project’s customer, offer, channel, and decision points rather than asking AI to make everything sound generic. Keep shared process instructions separate from project-specific content instructions. For a digital product, that may mean course structure, lesson quality, and learner outcomes; for a newsletter, it may mean source standards, recurring sections, and sponsor boundaries. Key factors include audience sophistication, buying stage, platform format, brand voice, and proof requirements. Run My AI Biz’s prompts are intended to be customized to a niche, audience, product, voice, and objective—not used unchanged across every venture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Separate shared process rules from project-specific audience, offer, channel, voice, and evidence instructions. Give each workflow examples of suitable language and required proof, then review whether the output fits the buyer’s stage and platform.
